caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, clay vessel with a wide cylindrical body, a short neck, and a spout extending diagonally from the lower right side of the body. The vessel is primarily an earthy brown color, with shading to indicate its rounded three-dimensional form. The rim of the vessel and the inside edge are slightly darker, with reddish-brown streaks or stains visible, suggesting possible residue from a previous liquid. Positioned to the left of the vessel is a separate lid, matching in color and material, with a knob handle at the center. The background of the drawing is plain and neutral, allowing the brown vessel and lid to stand out. The name "STANLEY MAZUR" is inscribed lightly in the lower right corner.
title: Batter Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
